title: Stolosio Overview
description: Demand, capacity, fleet response and event delivery. Empty counters mean no observations, not guaranteed success. Shared gauges use max; process counters use sum(rate()).

panels.title: Overview · acquisition success is not crawl success
Acquisition success
panels.description: No value means no acquisitions in the rate window. Provider connection success does not measure extracted data quality.

panels.title: Gateway sessions and intake limit
panels.description: Shared PostgreSQL snapshots are deduplicated with max across API replicas. Gateway totals ignore the provider filter.

panels.title: Acquisition attempts in selected period
panels.description: Prometheus estimates counts between scrapes. Percentiles with small samples are not reliable.

panels.title: CDP command p95 by domain
panels.description: Instrumentation groups methods into bounded domains such as Page and Runtime. Includes all providers and outcomes.

panels.title: Provider transitions / second
panels.description: All provider transitions, independent of the provider filter.

panels.title: Event pipeline · pending work distinguishes backlog from idle time
Last recorded batch event age
panels.description: Age of the newest event at batch processing time; stays unchanged when idle. Interpret alongside pending events, not as a standalone backlog alert.

panels.title: Publication failures and dead letters / second
Kubernetes resources · namespace scope; requires kubelet and kube-state-metrics
Most recent termination was OOMKilled
panels.description: Last termination reason, not an OOM event count; may remain set after recovery.

panels.title: Investigation · detailed session decisions live in the admin interface
Application logs
panels.description: Requires Loki logs with a namespace label. No logs may simply mean the selected period is quiet.
